r14_6_blocking_gaps: Matched state-by-state geometry evidence is incomplete outside the registered initial state and selected Variation, Putting, Explorer, Flight, and Launch Monitor interactions.
Approved baselines cover the initial React 1440x900 and PyQt 1.0-DPI states, not narrow React, PyQt 1.5 DPI, or representative loading, result, no-impact, failure, and stale states.

A user-oriented rendered review has not been approved with exact build and image identities.

The acceptance authority now binds every tab and registered state to reference cases, frame, units, provenance, limitation placement, keyboard path, and nonvisual alternatives; executed state/case geometry and exact artifact identities remain incomplete.

The new-tab extension checklist and downstream cross-repository validation are not yet consolidated into protected completion evidence.

Approve the representative rendered review with exact build and image identities.
